kind: Go dependent end-cap plane fixture and Rust candidate replay
go_command: Run generate.go in the Go application checkout with the source fixture and an output path.
observations: Go creates, saves, reopens and edits the cube with an end-cap offset plane.
Rust converts the Go cap reference and plane into a candidate, verifies its named body, and checks the plane frame and cap area through edit, undo, redo and native package reopen.
limitations: The Rust test prepares the prism candidate and adopts the resulting definitions in a test history; it does not open or migrate the entire Go package through the application.
The Go saved extrusion has fixed depth. Side-face key migration and solver-precision qualification remain open.
